title: CPA Licensure Examination (CPALE)
disclaimer: Original practice items for educational simulation only. Not affiliated with PRC/CSC.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Under the Conceptual Framework used in PH financial reporting (PFRS-aligned), the objective of general purpose financial reporting is primarily to provide information that is:
choices: Useful to existing and potential investors, lenders, and other creditors
questions.explanation: General purpose financial reports aim to provide decision-useful information to primary users.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: An item is recognized as an asset when it is probable that future economic benefits will flow to the entity and:
choices: The cost or value can be measured reliably
questions.explanation: Recognition criteria emphasize probable benefits and reliable measurement.

questions.subject: Advanced Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: In an acquisition, goodwill is generally measured as:
choices: Consideration transferred minus net identifiable assets acquired (simplified)
questions.explanation: Goodwill arises when consideration exceeds net identifiable assets acquired.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: Break-even point in units equals:
choices: Fixed costs / contribution margin per unit
questions.explanation: BEP units = FC / CM per unit.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: A flexible budget adjusts for changes in:
questions.explanation: Flexible budgets restate for actual activity levels.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Which is generally the most reliable form of audit evidence?
choices: External confirmation from a third party
questions.explanation: External confirmations are typically highly reliable.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Segregation of duties primarily helps prevent:
choices: Fraud and error by reducing opportunity for concealment
questions.explanation: SOD reduces opportunities for error and fraud.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: In the Philippines, the agency primarily administering national internal revenue taxes is:
questions.explanation: BIR administers national internal revenue taxes.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: VAT in the Philippines is generally a tax on:
choices: Consumption / value added on sale of goods/services (with rules/exceptions)
Only real property tax at LGU exclusively
questions.explanation: VAT is an indirect tax on consumption under the NIRC framework.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: Under the Civil Code, a contract generally requires:
choices: Only government license for all private sales of candy
questions.explanation: Essential requisites: consent, object, and cause.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: A partnership in Philippine law is formed by:
choices: Two or more persons binding themselves to contribute money/property/industry to a common fund with intention to divide profits
questions.explanation: Partnership definition tracks Civil Code provisions.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Which inventory cost flow assumption is an accounting policy choice that can affect COGS and ending inventory under PFRS?
questions.explanation: FIFO (and weighted average; LIFO not allowed under IFRS/PFRS).

questions.subject: Advanced Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Consolidated financial statements are generally prepared when a parent:
choices: Owns any single share of any company
questions.explanation: Control drives consolidation of subsidiaries.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: In a special order decision, management should focus on:
choices: Sunk costs from five years ago only
Historical purchase price of the factory land only
questions.explanation: Relevant costs/revenues differ among alternatives.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: An unmodified opinion means the auditor concludes financial statements are:
choices: Presented fairly, in all material respects, in accordance with the applicable framework
Free from all immaterial typos somehow certified impossible
questions.explanation: Unmodified opinion = fair presentation in all material respects.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: Expanded withholding tax in the PH system generally requires certain payors to:
choices: Withhold and remit tax on specified income payments
questions.explanation: EWT requires withholding agents to withhold/remit on covered payments.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: A negotiable promissory note must be:
choices: An unconditional promise in writing to pay a sum certain in money, among other NIL requisites
questions.explanation: NIL sets formal requisites for negotiability.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Under PFRS 15, revenue from contracts with customers is recognized when:
choices: Performance obligations are satisfied (control transfers), subject to the 5-step model
Cash is always received regardless of performance
The board votes without a contract
questions.explanation: PFRS 15 uses a five-step model.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: Net present value (NPV) decision rule for independent projects typically accepts when NPV is:
questions.explanation: Positive NPV projects are expected to add value.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Independence is critical in auditing because it:
choices: Supports unbiased assurance and public confidence
questions.explanation: Independence underpins audit credibility.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: A non-VAT registered person in the PH may be subject to percentage tax on:
choices: Certain gross receipts subject to rules
questions.explanation: Percentage taxes apply to certain non-VAT taxpayers/receipts under the NIRC.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Depreciation allocates the depreciable amount of an asset over:
questions.explanation: Depreciation is systematic allocation over useful life.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: A favorable materials price variance means actual price was:
questions.explanation: Favorable price variance: actual < standard price.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: Under the Revised Corporation Code of the Philippines, a corporation is:
choices: An artificial being created by operation of law
questions.explanation: A corporation is an artificial being created by law.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Inherent risk is the susceptibility of an assertion to misstatement:
choices: After all controls operate perfectly always
questions.explanation: Inherent risk is assessed before considering controls.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: The primary users of general purpose financial statements include:
questions.explanation: Investors and creditors are key GPFS users.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Under PFRS 15, revenue is recognized when:
choices: Cash is always received regardless of performance
questions.explanation: Revenue follows satisfaction of performance obligations.

questions.subject: Advanced Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Goodwill in a business combination arises when:
choices: Consideration is less than net identifiable assets always
Consideration exceeds the net of identifiable assets acquired and liabilities assumed
questions.explanation: Goodwill reflects excess consideration over net identifiable amounts.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: Contribution margin equals:
questions.explanation: CM = Sales − Variable costs.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: A flexible budget adjusts primarily for:
choices: Only CEO preferences with no activity link
questions.explanation: Flexible budgets restate costs/revenues for actual activity.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Detection risk is the risk that:
choices: Auditor procedures will not detect a material misstatement
questions.explanation: Detection risk relates to audit procedures failing to detect misstatements.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Which is generally more reliable?
choices: External confirmation from a third party
questions.explanation: External confirmations are often highly reliable evidence.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: In Philippine income taxation, deductible ordinary and necessary expenses generally must be:
choices: Ordinary, necessary, and substantiated in trade or business
questions.explanation: Deductible expenses must be ordinary, necessary, and properly supported.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: VAT on vatable sales of goods is generally based on:
choices: Gross selling price / appropriate tax base under the NIRC rules
questions.explanation: VAT follows statutory tax bases such as gross selling price/deemed values.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: An obligation is a juridical necessity to:
choices: Give, to do, or not to do
questions.explanation: Civil Code: obligation is to give, to do, or not to do.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: A contract that is absolutely simulated is generally:
questions.explanation: Absolute simulation typically renders a contract void.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Under PAS 2, inventories are measured at:
choices: Lower of cost and net realizable value
questions.explanation: Inventories are at lower of cost and NRV.

questions.subject: Advanced Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: A foreign currency transaction monetary item is generally retranslated at:
questions.explanation: Monetary items are translated at the closing rate.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: A sunk cost is:
choices: A past cost not relevant to future decisions
questions.explanation: Sunk costs are past and typically irrelevant going forward.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: Segregation of duties primarily reduces:
choices: Opportunity for fraud and error through combined incompatible functions
questions.explanation: Separating custody, recording, and authorization strengthens control.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: Percentage tax generally applies to:
choices: Certain persons exempt from VAT / as provided by law
questions.explanation: Percentage tax applies in cases set by the NIRC (e.g., non-VAT persons).

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Depreciation allocates the depreciable amount of an asset:
choices: Only to retained earnings directly always
questions.explanation: Depreciation is systematic allocation over useful life.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: A check is generally an instrument that is:
choices: Drawn on a bank payable on demand
questions.explanation: A check is a bill of exchange drawn on a bank payable on demand.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: NPV accepts a project when:
choices: NPV is zero or positive (at the hurdle rate framework used)
Payback is ignored always and NPV never used
questions.explanation: Positive (or non-negative) NPV indicates value creation at the discount rate.

questions.subject: Auditing
questions.stem: An unmodified opinion means the auditor concludes FS are:
choices: Presented fairly, in all material respects
questions.explanation: Unmodified opinion = fair presentation in all material respects.

questions.subject: Taxation
questions.stem: Expanded withholding tax generally obligates certain payors to:
choices: Withhold and remit tax on specific income payments
questions.explanation: EWT requires withholding/remittance on covered payments.

questions.subject: Advanced Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: In the absence of an agreement, partnership profits are shared:
questions.explanation: Civil Code default: equal sharing if silent.

questions.subject: Financial Accounting and Reporting
questions.stem: Interest paid is often classified under PAS 7 as:
choices: Operating or financing (accounting policy / presentation rules)
questions.explanation: PAS 7 allows certain classification choices with consistency.

questions.subject: Regulatory Framework for Business Transactions
questions.stem: Risk of loss in a sale of goods generally passes based on:
choices: Delivery / intention and agreed terms under the Civil Code rules
Never until resale to a fourth party
questions.explanation: Transfer of ownership/risk follows delivery and contractual intent rules.

questions.subject: Management Advisory Services
questions.stem: A cost center manager is primarily evaluated on:
choices: Controllable costs / efficiency of resource use
questions.explanation: Cost centers focus on cost control and efficiency.
